description: Source code for QboneServerSession class and related helper functions in the quiche QUIC implementation, handling server-side session management, control stream creation, packet processing, and encryption level management.

classes.name: QboneCryptoServerStreamHelper
classes.description: Helper class for handling client hello acceptance in Qbone server sessions.

classes.name: QboneServerSession
classes.description: Manages server-side QUIC session for Qbone, including control stream creation, packet processing, and encryption management.

methods.name: CanAcceptClientHello
methods.description: Checks if the client hello message can be accepted based on ALPN protocol.

methods.name: QboneServerSession
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a Qbone server session with configuration and network parameters.

methods.name: CreateCryptoStream
methods.description: Creates a cryptographic stream for the session.

methods.name: CreateControlStream
methods.description: Creates and activates a control stream if not already created.

methods.name: CreateControlStreamFromPendingStream
methods.description: Creates a control stream from a pending stream object.

methods.name: SetDefaultEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Sets the default encryption level and creates control stream upon reaching forward secure encryption.

methods.name: SendClientRequest
methods.description: Sends a client request over the control stream.

methods.name: ProcessPacketFromNetwork
methods.description: Processes a packet received from the network.

methods.name: ProcessPacketFromPeer
methods.description: Processes a packet received from the peer.

methods.name: SendPacketToClient
methods.description: Sends a packet to the client.

methods.name: SendPacketToNetwork
methods.description: Sends a packet to the network via the writer.
